page_title: AURA Switcher — безкоштовна альтернатива Punto Switcher для Mac і Windows

summary.name: AURA Switcher
summary.one_liner: A free, open-source Ukrainian keyboard layout switcher for macOS and Windows that automatically fixes text typed in the wrong layout after a space.
use_cases: Fixing words typed in the wrong keyboard layout automatically
Replacing Punto Switcher or Caramba Switcher
Converting selected text to another layout with a double Shift press
Switching Ukrainian and English input on macOS or Windows
Keeping keyboard layout tools free and offline
summary.what_it_does:
AURA Switcher watches typing and, after a space, replaces a word typed in the wrong layout with the correct text and switches the layout (e.g. «ghbdsn» becomes «привіт»). Pressing Shift twice converts the last word or selected text to another layout. It can be set to keep a fixed layout in specific apps, such as Terminal (always EN) or Telegram (UK), and stays silent in excluded programs. The page says it runs locally, sends nothing to the internet, and is under 1 MB. It supports all layouts installed in the system, with Ukrainian, English, German, Polish and Greek named.</what_it_does>
